problem: Opening full-plan refinement immediately after saving an action can clone the previous plan while the route refresh is still pending. The current-revision guard then rejects the preview.
visibleError: The saved plan changed. Your working copy is still here; review the latest plan before generating another preview.
checksBeforeFailure: Real password sign-in to protected immutable staging preview
Minimal family intake with two barriers and no description
Live AI generation of three persisted goals
No invented phone/email in the no-directory draft
Zero automated WCAG 2A/AA and 2.1AA plan-page violations
Waiting edit saved and survived reload
Live action refinement required explicit field selection and preserved the manual task and waiting note
fix: Reuse the existing pending transition and save state to disable and guard opening full-plan refinement until the current save/refresh finishes. Preserve all revision checks.

regression.test: waits for an action save before opening full-plan refinement with the refreshed plan
regression.beforeFix: Failed: the full-plan refinement button remained enabled while the action save was pending
regression.afterFix: Passed, including the refreshed revision and saved manual task reaching the subsequent AI request
regression.browserRegression: Existing intake-to-PDF workflow extended with full-plan refinement and exact preservation of saved action rows; remote CI and fresh hosted candidate still required

review: Normal correctness/security/privacy/accessibility/regression review and a separate Ponytail deletion pass completed; two application lines reuse existing state, with no new dependency or authorization change
priorAttemptFailures: Vercel env run from the repository loaded .env.local despite an empty remote Development scope. The runner's credential guard stopped before browser, fixture or application requests; a clean temporary working directory resolved this without loading application/provider keys.
The first browser runner assumed one task Status selector. Live generation returned multiple tasks; the selector was narrowed to the intended first task.
The first full-plan attempt waited for a preview without watching the error alert. A diagnostic attempt captured the reproducible saved-plan-changed message. No AI preview was applied.
limits: This record proves the defect and focused fix, not a passing hosted full-plan/PDF/assistant journey. Follow-up candidate verification is required.
